nrho_reference.meaning: Interpolation fidelity to the design SPK, not flight navigation accuracy

reference_seed.label: Integrator regression seed only; Mode B departures use nrho_reference at the actual departure time
reference_seed.provenance: Geometric spkezr(-60000, epoch, J2000, NONE, MOON). SPK original origin is Earth, transformed using DE440s. Not a flown/operational ephemeris.
reference_seed.source_force_model: Published reference uses DE430, DE431 GMs, Earth/Moon/Sun/Jupiter and lunar 8x8 gravity plus small stationkeeping impulses.
reference_seed.runtime_force_model: Mode B reads its departure state from the source SPK subset at departure UTC, then integrates selected lunar gravity and differential Earth/Sun attraction; no subsequent source samples replace integrated states.

propagation_method: Independent SciPy DOP853, direct SPICE Earth/Sun states at every RHS evaluation, rtol=2e-13; no browser ephemeris interpolation
source_reference_caveat: Departure states come directly from the bounded NASA SPK subset. All post-departure states are integrated; the retained seed/golden_propagation only test the integrator independently.
